ActivityCreateIntent.description: P5.8a: create an Activity owned by the authenticated caller.
ActivityCreateIntent.title: ActivityCreateIntent

ActivityJoinIntent.description: P5.8a: join an Activity by its 8-digit code. Never a Participant claim.
ActivityJoinIntent.title: ActivityJoinIntent

ActivityMemberRemoveIntent.description: P5.8c: remove another user's membership. Creator-only.
ActivityMemberRemoveIntent.title: ActivityMemberRemoveIntent

CanonicalExpenseUpdatePatch.description: Fully bound expense fields. No semantic refs remain after confirmation.
CanonicalExpenseUpdatePatch.title: CanonicalExpenseUpdatePatch

ExpenseRefundIntent.description:
Linked refund intent (P5.4). Amounts are positive magnitudes.

The write is a negative Expense carrying ``original_expense_id``; the
currency and FX snapshot are inherited from the original, never chosen here.
ExpenseRefundIntent.title: ExpenseRefundIntent

FinalSettlementIntent.description:
Server-plan-bound final settlement intent (P5.7).

This records a payment the user says already happened, but only when the
server's current plan contains exactly this item.
FinalSettlementIntent.title: FinalSettlementIntent

FinalSettlementPlanItem.description: One item of the server's complete current final-settlement plan.
FinalSettlementPlanItem.title: FinalSettlementPlanItem

FinalSettlementPreview.description: One selected plan item plus the complete plan it must come from.
FinalSettlementPreview.title: FinalSettlementPreview

FixedActivityCreateCommand.description: P5.8a. The server fixes the creator from the caller's own identity.
FixedActivityCreateCommand.title: FixedActivityCreateCommand

FixedExpenseRefundCommand.description: P5.4 linked refund. Amounts stay positive here; the RPC payload negates them.
FixedExpenseRefundCommand.title: FixedExpenseRefundCommand

FixedFinalSettlementCommand.description: P5.7 final settlement of one item from the server's current plan.
FixedFinalSettlementCommand.title: FixedFinalSettlementCommand

FixedNegativeAdjustmentCommand.description: P5.4 explicit unlinked negative Expense. It never references an original.
FixedNegativeAdjustmentCommand.title: FixedNegativeAdjustmentCommand

FixedPrepaymentCommand.description: P5.6 prepayment: the server splits the amount into settlement + balance.
FixedPrepaymentCommand.title: FixedPrepaymentCommand

FixedPrepaymentReturnCommand.description: P5.6 prepayment return. The remaining balance is the server's answer.
FixedPrepaymentReturnCommand.title: FixedPrepaymentReturnCommand

ManagementPreview.description:
P5.8a Activity / Participant management preview.

These operations are not bound to an existing Activity scope: creating or
joining an Activity happens before one exists, and the proposal therefore
carries no Activity id for those two.
ManagementPreview.title: ManagementPreview

NegativeAdjustmentIntent.description: Explicit unlinked negative Expense (P5.4). Never a silent refund fallback.
NegativeAdjustmentIntent.title: NegativeAdjustmentIntent

NegativeAdjustmentPreview.description: Explicit unlinked negative Expense. There is no original to inherit from.
NegativeAdjustmentPreview.title: NegativeAdjustmentPreview

ParticipantClaimIntent.description: P5.8b: claim one existing Participant as the caller's identity.
ParticipantClaimIntent.title: ParticipantClaimIntent

PrepaymentIntent.description: Server-trusted prepayment intent (P5.6). Any Member may fund an account.
PrepaymentIntent.title: PrepaymentIntent

PrepaymentPreview.description: Server-previewed prepayment: debt settlement and balance top-up, split.
PrepaymentPreview.title: PrepaymentPreview

PrepaymentReturnPreview.description:
Account balance is read; the post-return balance is the server's answer.

There is deliberately no post-return balance field: it cannot be computed
from the preview, so the card must not show one.

post_balance_note.const: 返还后余额以服务端执行结果为准
post_balance_note.default: 返还后余额以服务端执行结果为准
post_balance_note.title: Post Balance Note

PrepaymentReturnPreview.title: PrepaymentReturnPreview

ProposalExecutionAccepted.description:
HTTP 202: the confirmation dispatched exactly one durable execution.

The response reports the Turn as it stands *after* dispatch. An unknown
outcome is presented as RECOVERING/UNKNOWN, never as a success claim.
ProposalExecutionAccepted.title: ProposalExecutionAccepted

RefundPreview.description: Linked refund preview: the original, what is already refunded, and the cap.
RefundPreview.title: RefundPreview

RepaymentIntent.description: Server-trusted repayment intent (P5.5a). IDs are already scope-bound.
RepaymentIntent.title: RepaymentIntent

RequestReceipt.description: Four-table placement is defined in the freeze document; response snapshots contain no nonce.
RequestReceipt.title: RequestReceipt

TurnPublicStatus.description: Client-visible state; owner identity and private bindings remain server-side.
TurnPublicStatus.title: TurnPublicStatus

VoidTransferIntent.description: Server-trusted void intent (P5.5b). The transfer type is read server-side.
VoidTransferIntent.title: VoidTransferIntent
